visualCharacteristics: rc16: Light grey vertical gradient (#f5f7fa to white). New block as directed: heading + button left, rounded portrait photo right; a later form embed can slot into the text cell.

contentPattern.authoring: One row, two cells: cell 1 H2 and a bold link to /en-us/contact (renders as the primary button); cell 2 image only.

usage.description: Contact prompt: heading and button link beside a rounded portrait photo (stands in for the Marketo form).

reuseGuidance: Use where a page invites visitors to the contact page. No form fields; a form embed can later go in the text cell.
